caption: The drawing depicts a single, cylindrical metal object positioned centrally against a plain, light beige background. The object has a flat circular top and bottom, and its vertical side is inscribed with engraved text reading “C. CROLIUS MANUFACTURE MANHATTAN-WELLS NEW-YORK” in block letters, mostly blue. The metal surface displays a tarnished appearance with areas of brownish discoloration and irregular blue and gray markings, suggesting age or oxidation. The top of the cylinder has a raised, circular central section with a hole in the middle and three smaller holes spaced evenly near the edges. The light source appears to come from the upper left, casting subtle shading and highlights on the object, giving it a three-dimensional appearance. The object is isolated, with no other items present in the composition, and there is an artist signature “FUMAGALLI” in the lower right corner.
title: Inkwell
